description: Pick up a gantry toolhead from the rack. Approaches the slot at the chosen speed, then engages at a fixed 50 RPM: onto the tool, dip along -Y, lift back to seat it, and withdraw along +X. If another toolhead is already held it is dropped into its own slot first. Errors before moving if the sequence would leave the usable workspace.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that drives the CoreXY gantry.

inputs.label: Toolhead
inputs.description: Which toolhead to pick up (1-6). If a different toolhead is already held it is automatically returned to its own slot first.

inputs.label: Approach Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Speed for the initial approach move only. Every step after it runs at a fixed 50 RPM.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY A Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY A Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY B Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY B Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advanced_inputs.label: X Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: X Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X maximum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y minimum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin reserved for a Y maximum limit switch. This machine has no Y-max switch wired; the pin is held inactive by its pull-up and never blocks a move. The usable Y range is bounded by the Y track length and the 5 mm buffers instead. Optional: -1 means no Y-max limit switch is wired.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 1 X (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact X position of toolhead 1 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Approach Clearance (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: How far along +X the gantry stands off the rack when approaching and leaving.

advanced_inputs.label: Dip Depth (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: How far along -Y the gantry pulls to engage or release a tool. Needs this much room below the tool.

advanced_inputs.label: Engage Lift (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Small +Y move back after the dip that seats the tool on the gantry.

advanced_inputs.label: Release Offset (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: How far along +Y the gantry rises past the slot position to unhook the tool before settling back onto the slot Y. The drop retraces the pickup exit path.

outputs.label: Next
outputs.description: Continue when the tool change completes.

firmware_requirements.protocol: Serial commands: SET XY PINS, SET XY ENABLE, SET XY LIMITS, GOTOXY <xCm> <yCm> <rpm> <trapezoidFlag> <accelerationRpmPerSecond>. The block issues the tool-change waypoints as a series of GOTOXY moves; no dedicated firmware routine is required.
firmware_requirements.description: Firmware routine required by the Pick Up Toolhead block.
